## 席位核对
ACCEPT — PR #36546 @ 1116647a9a4f34eb2d480b7771d20fa033548e0a · card #35505 · L1 first read by area s2-B (area order rule 9) · 2026-11-22T22:51Z

- **Shape:** open, draft, base `main`; first line `Fixes #35505` and the PR delivers all four items of ruling 7077818174; no closing keyword near another card (`l1-face.mjs --pr 36546` CLEAN).
- **Premise:** held (claim 7084895962).
- **Scope:** 17 files, 638+/51-, all `ui/**`: `appRoute.ts` (`resolveApprovalsHostSegment`, `isApprovalsInboxLink`), `objectHostApp.ts` (`orSetup: false`), new `console/setupAliasApprovals.ts`, `AppContent.tsx` / `ConsoleShell.tsx` (alias move before chrome mounts; docblocks), `HomePage.tsx`, `InboxPopover.tsx`, `ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx`, tests, one changeset. `RecordDetailView.tsx`, `approvalQueueAdvance.tsx`, `PhoneAppNavBar.tsx` and `approval-service.ts` untouched. Not governed (`check-governed-merges.mjs`), 689 lines. `@object-ui/app-shell` is `private: true`, so the `@object-ui/console` changeset is the published entry.
- **Diff read against the ruling:** (1) order — the request page asks `objectHostAppSegment(…, { orSetup: false })` (the object's own app), then `resolveApprovalsHostSegment` gives current → last used (`useLastApp`) → first app, `resolveHostAppSegment`'s last resorts after that; `/system/approvals…` reaches `/apps/setup/system/approvals` and `useSetupAliasApprovalsTarget` moves it on before any chrome mounts (so Setup is not recorded as the last app), keeping search and hash; Setup's own package-id address is left alone. (2) the deep link carries the host app's approvals inbox as the way back; Home and the bell hand the pending queue, notifications and the e-mail link only the way back. (3) Setup stays when it is the current or last used app (the `host === SETUP_APP_NAME` branch). (4) pin flipped.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/35505-approval-host-app.md`, read sentence by sentence: the four-step order, "Setup is the answer only when it is the current or the last used app", the `/system/approvals?request=ID` forward, close/back to the inbox, the queue from Home and the bell, "the e-mail link and a notification carry only the way back", Setup's own address unchanged — each matches the diff.
- **Pins:** flipped `ApprovalsInboxPage.opensServedPage-12484.test.tsx` ("opens under Setup" → stays in the app it was opened from, plus a CONTROL for an open from Setup) and `AppContent.setupItemRoutesVerdict-12706.test.tsx` (`/system/approvals` CONTROL now `/apps/crm/system/approvals`); forced `HomePage.myWork-12602.test.tsx` (navigate gains the queue state). Checked, not flipped: `record-pointer-card-renderer.test.tsx:296` pins the RECORD link rule (objectstack#32667), which the ruling does not cover — correct to leave.
- **Tests and gates:** 15 files / 192 tests locally under the lock; four ablations each red (1 / 3 / 5 / 3 failures). Check-runs at this head: 41 success, 15 expected skip, 0 failed, 0 pending; Lint & Repo Gates and TypeScript Type Check `success`, Test UI 16/16 green. Ledger `/mnt/project-files/objectstack-seat2/35505-gates-ran.txt` (39 families, 0 NOT-MEASURED). `HomePage.myWork-12602` was not measured locally (lock waits) — its reading is CI's, green at this head.
- **Area choices on the dev's open questions:** (1) the last used app applies to approval links only, as shipped — the ruling covers approvals, other Home drills keep their rule. (2) keep the bounded 2 s wait for the last used app on a cold link (same as the phone landing's).
- **Out of scope:** `ui/packages/app-shell/README.md`'s Setup paragraph is now stale (private package, outside the claim surface) — Acceptance notes, not filed. Whether a RECORD link with no listing app should follow the same order — not ruled; noted, not filed.
- **Landing:** non-governed, ≤3000 lines, K = 7 (< 15) ⇒ area lands it in this stroke.
